## What does this change?
- [ ] New ODK submission(s) — hazard: ______ · country: ______ · period: ______
- [ ] Correction to an existing submission
- [ ] Questionnaire / config change (`data/questions`, `data/config`)
- [ ] Dashboard code (`src/`)

## Checklist
- [ ] The CSV is in `data/submissions/<hazard>/` and named `<period>_<country>.csv`
- [ ] The automated validation report shows **0 errors**
- [ ] No personal data or API keys are included
- [ ] Screenshot attached (for dashboard changes)
